description:
Save your writing Voice (replaces the previous one — it is a per-npub
singleton). ``profile`` is free text. ``bans`` is a list of ``{text, on}``
objects: ``text`` is the construction to avoid, ``on`` whether it is an active
constraint. Blank/duplicate entries are dropped server-side. Owner-scoped;
priced by the operator's pricing model (use ``check_price``). Returns
``{"success": true, "voice": {...}}``.

bans.description:
Up to 200 ``{"text": str, "on": bool}`` objects, each ``text`` up
to 200 characters; null saves an empty list.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

profile.description:
Free-text description of your writing voice, up to 4000
characters.

name: excalibur_save_voice
title: Save your Voice
